description: Search the localities of one county by name (diacritics ignored), in pages. Use it to get a locality id or confirm a spelling; to prepare an order use create_order_link, which also accepts the name.

county.description: The county: its numeric id as text (from list_counties) or its name, with or without diacritics.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Part of the locality name. Omit to page through all localities of the county.

name: search_localities
title: Search localities
